title: Normalized tower lissity propagation from native level-zero models
statement:
theorem normalizedTower_lisse_of_native_strata
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (S : Stratification X) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbounded : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))
    (hnative : ∀ (i : Fin S.n) (q : ℤ),
      ∃ c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage (S.immersion i) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (adicLisseConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))) ≅
          adicLisseConstantRing (S.domain i) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)),
        NormalizedNativeSieveFiniteLisse (S.domain i)
          (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))
          ((proEtaleRingModulePullback (S.immersion i)
            (adicLisseConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)))
            (adicLisseConstantRing (S.domain i) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))) c).obj
            ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d 0).hom).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level 0))))) :
    ∀ (i : Fin S.n) (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule (S.immersion i)
        (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (S.immersion i)).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback (S.immersion i)
                ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))

proof.text: Restrict each level along pbcLevelConstantComparison to obtain a native constant-coefficient complex K_n. Exact restriction transfers the common upper bound. At level zero use finite_native_models_relative_lisse for the supplied arbitrary coefficient isomorphism. Exact inverse-image homology and the identity-coefficient pullback comparison give relative finite lissity of the pulled-back K_0.

proof.text: Induct through successive quotient maps A/I^(n+2) to A/I^(n+1). Each map is surjective and its kernel has square zero: I^(2(n+1)) lies in I^(n+2). The coefficient-comparison naturality square and uniqueness of left adjoints identify derived scalar extension of K_(n+1) with K_n using tower normalization. Apply relative_finite_lisse_of_nilpotent_reduction and the induction hypothesis.
